articles.body:
This page of IGN's Mass Effect Legendary Edition wiki guide covers all the key choices you can make in all three games, including what their effects and consequences are across the trilogy.

One of the hallmarks of the Mass Effect Trilogy is its ability to let you make choices for Shepard during conversations, story moments and gameplay, with effects ranging for very minor to far-reaching across the galaxy. These pages document the most notable choices and consequences across all three games.

It goes without saying that there are HEAVY spoilers in these pages across ALL THREE GAMES. READ AT YOUR OWN RISK , and don't scroll down too quickly!

If you want to go to the Choices page for each game (where we also list the Moderate Choices), click one of the links below.

Below, we'll list all of the major choices and consequences you make across the Mass Effect Trilogy, arranged roughly chronologically. The choices for each decision are listed first, followed by the consequences of each within a Spoiler Box.

To jump to a specific section of this page, click one of the links below.

It's entirely possible to complete the " Citadel: Expose Saren " Mission without meeting Garrus Vakarian at the Med Clinic (however this requires meeting and recruiting Urdnot Wrex). If that's the case, he'll be waiting for you outside the central C-Sec elevator after you've exposed Saren and been made a Spectre. From here you can decide if you want to recruit him:

It's entirely possible to complete the " Citadel: Expose Saren " Mission without meeting Urdnot Wrex at C-Sec (however this requires meeting and recruiting Garrus Vakarian). If that's the case, he'll be waiting for you outside the central C-Sec elevator after you've exposed Saren and been made a Spectre. From here you can decide if you want to recruit him:

One of your early Missions is to Find Liara T'Soni in the Artemis Tau cluster . Her reaction to you can differ greatly depending on whether you complete more than one Mission World before going after her.

Find Liara after one or fewer Mission Worlds - Tap to Reveal

Find Liara after Feros and Noveria - Tap to Reveal

Find Liara after Virmire - Tap to Reveal

At the end of the Feros Mission line , you'll have the opportunity to complete side-quest Assignments, use Charm / Intimidate to convince Fai Dan, and use special gas grenades to help ensure the survival of the colony . The fate of the colony is then decided by a survival check based on whether you did these actions.

At the very end of the Noveria Mission line , you'll have an encounter with the Rachni Queen, and must choose whether to spare her and let her escape, or kill her with acid.

The DLC Mission Bring Down the Sky has an important decision at the end, where you must choose between saving the hostages and let Balak go, or sacrifice them so you can attack Balak.

Early into the Mission on Virmire , you'll learn that Saren has found a cure for the Genophage in this lab, and Wrex is furious that it'll be destroyed. You'll have to confront him at the beach to find a resolution.

To convince Wrex to stand down, you'll need to have 8 Charm points or have completed the " Wrex: Family Armor " Assignment in order to open up the requisite options to save him. Otherwise, you can shoot him yourself, order Ashley to shoot him if you told her to "Stay Alert" earlier, or can't find a resolution that will result in Ashley killing him herself.

Towards the end of Virmire , you'll be forced to choose to rescue either Kaidan or Ashley, who will be at the bomb site and the AA tower (who is where depends on who you assigned to Kirrahe's team before the assault).

At the end of the Virmire Mission, you'll get into an extended conversation with Saren over his alliance with Sovereign. Towards the end you'll have an Investigate option on the left side: this marks when the important final choice with Saren will appear.

If you pick "It's already happened!" or "You are indoctrinated", you'll open up Persuasion options that will have an effect later in the game if you then choose those.

In your last conversation with Saren , you'll have the option to convince him to resist the Reaper implants. This requires a full 12 points into either your Charm or Intimidate stat, but if you picked the Charm / Intimidate option back on Virmire, you'll only need 9 points. If you can't, you'll have to pick "This is pointless".

During the finale of Mass Effect 1 , after encountering Saren you'll have to choose whether or not to order the Alliance Fleet to save the Destiny Ascension, or ignore it to focus on Sovereign.

Save the Destiny Ascension - Tap to Reveal

Through your actions in the final Mission , you'll be able to choose the Human Councilor who will join / lead the Citadel Council, between Udina and Anderson.

During " Zaeed: The Price of Revenge ", you'll be forced to either help some factory workers escape the exploding facility, or ignore them and go after Vido. If you chose the former Paragon option, Vido will escape and Zaeed will get himself trapped under some debris. There are three possible outcomes here.

"You brought this on yourself" - Tap to Reveal

One of the earliest ways you can affect how the Suicide Mission plays out is to purchase three specific upgrades for the Normandy to bolster its defenses and firepower. Not purchasing one will guarantee a profoundly negative effect during a Suicide Mission scene that tests that attribute of the Normandy.

After you complete the Mission " Dossier: The Warlord ", you'll wind up back on the Normandy with Dr. Okeer's tank-bred Krogan in lieu of the doctor. At this point, you have the choice to open the tank or keep it sealed.

In the second half of Mass Effect 2, you can acquire Miranda's Loyalty Mission, " Miranda: The Prodigal ". Completing or Ignoring this Mission will have a direct effect on Mass Effect 3.

After you complete " Miranda: The Prodigal " and " Jack: Subject Zero " (their Loyalty Missions), when you next return to the Normandy you'll have to settle a big argument between the two. Successfully calming both of them down requires passing a very high Persuasion Check.

At the end of Mordin's Loyalty Mission, " Mordin: Old Blood ", you'll be faced with the choice of either destroying Maelon's research data, or holding on to it. This will have a direct effect on a character in Mass Effect 3.

Samara's Loyalty Mission, " Samara: The Ardat-Yakshi ", is one of the few where it's possible to fail it, and is the only one where failure can occur at two different points. These are when you enter the club to attract Morinth's interest, and when talking to Morinth herself at the club table. If you fail to complete four club activities, or choose the wrong questions and responses at the club table, Morinth will leave.

At the end of Samara's Loyalty Mission, " Samara: The Ardat-Yakshi ", you meet up with Morinth in her apartment, and Morinth will seduce you. If you can pass the extremely high Persuasion check and avoid "Can't... think...", you'll resist her, and will now be able to choose between Samara or Morinth in the final confrontation, rather than siding with Samara automatically.

Thane's Loyalty Mission, " Thane: Sins of the Father ", is yet another that can be completed with him being Disloyal to you. Towards the end of the Mission you'll be in some upper catwalks, and must periodically inform Thane of the position of a Turian politician named Talid. You'll have a limited amount of time to do so.

Tali's Loyalty Mission, " Tali: Treason ", is one that you can complete but have Tali come out Disloyal to you anyway. It all depends on what you pick at the end of Tali's trial, and what you choose won't just affect Tali's Loyalty, but Mass Effect 3 as well.

Charm / Intimidate / Rally the Crowd - Tap to Reveal

"Yes. Here is the evidence" - Tap to Reveal

After you complete the Reaper IFF mission at the Derelict Reaper , you'll have escaped with the shell of a Geth Sniper who shows familiarity with Shepard. Once you're back on the Normandy, you can go to the AI Core to decide whether activate the Geth to talk with it first, or sell it to Cerberus.

Activate the Geth Sniper - Tap to Reveal

Sell the Geth Sniper - Tap to Reveal Tap to Reveal

After you complete both the " Tali: Treason " and " Legion: A House Divided " Loyalty Missions, when you next board the Normandy you'll find them in a big argument. As with Jack and Miranda, you'll need to pass a very high Persuasion check so you can pick a Charm / Intimidate option that settles both parties without making them Disloyal.

After you complete the Reaper IFF Mission on the derelict Reaper , the Collectors eventually will show up and steal the Normandy's crew in the Mission known as " Joker's Jump " (this happens after you complete four non-DLC Missions and/or Assignments, or run out of of them, whichever happens first).

Once the crew is taken, the amount of Missions and Assignments you complete before starting the Suicide Mission directly impacts the fate of the Normandy's crew.

Delay of 1-3 Missions and / or Assignments - Tap to Reveal

Delay of 4 Missions and / or Assignments - Tap to Reveal

The very last decision you'll make at the end of Mass Effect 2's storyline will be to decide what to do with the Collector Base, which happens at the end of the Suicide Mission . You can choose to either destroy it, or save it. This may have a direct effect on Mass Effect 3.

Destroy the Collector Base - Tap to Reveal

The Suicide Mission is easily the most important Mission in Mass Effect 2: the way you prepare for it and the Loyalties of your team will have a huge effect on how the mission will go. On top of that, specific choices and calls you make during the Mission can also major effects on the Squad and Mass Effect 3, sometimes regardless of how well you prepared beforehand.

For a full breakdown on what effects your decisions will have, visit the How the Suicide Mission Works page of the Mass Effect 2 guide.

To see how specific Squad Mate deaths will affect Mass Effect 3, visit the Suicide Mission Deaths Consequences section of Mass Effect 2's dedicated Choices and Consequences page.

During " Priority: Mars ", the first full Mission of the game, you'll be accompanied by your Virmire Survivor, who'll be either Kaidan or Ashley. Your choices here will have an effect on what they think of you later in the game, which will be very important.

Starting with " Priority: Mars ", you'll have four conversations with The Illusive Man about his intentions and the state of the Galaxy. Which choices you have in the first three will have a very major effect on how the fourth one will play out. It all depends on if you can pick every Charm / Intimidate option in these conversations, INCLUDING the ones hidden under Investigate options.

Used all Charm / Intimidate options - Tap to Reveal

Didn't use all Charm / Intimidate options - Tap to Reveal

After " Priority: Mars ", Shepard will be able to amass War Assets by completing Missions, Assignments, and helping the citizens of the Milky Way. These increase your Effective Military Strength, or EMS, and this number will have a profound effect on the game's finale.

After " Priority: Palaven ", you'll be given the " Grissom Academy: Emergency Evacuation " Mission. While other early Missions will also expire if you don't complete them before " Priority: The Citadel 2 ", this particular Mission has stronger consequences if you let that happen.

Grissom Academy completed - Tap to Reveal

In the finale of the Krogan storyline, " Priority: Tuchanka ", you'll learn before starting the Mission that the Shroud was in fact sabotaged by the Dalatrass to ensure that any Genophage cure wouldn't work. While in a vehicle convoy to the Shroud, you'll have the opportunity to bring this up to the STG Doctor (either Maelon or Wiks) and the Krogan Leaders with you in the vehicle.

This particular choice will have a direct bearing on how the end of the Mission will go, and determines the fate of the Krogan. The effects of NOT warning the Krogan leaders specifically will depend on if Wrex and/or Eve are dead.

Don't warn them (Wrex and / or Eve are alive - Tap to Reveal

Don't warn them (Wrex and Eve both dead) - Tap to Reveal

Throughout Mass Effect 3 you'll have three conversations with Miranda on the Citadel, provided she survived Mass Effect 2. While the first conversation is inconsequential, the second and third have requirements that you MUST meet in order to have her live through her storyline.

The first is with your second conversation with her after " Priority: The Citadel 2 ", and requires you to Tap to Reveal .

The second is in your third conversation , where you Tap to Reveal .

If you Romanced Miranda, an extra third requirement is to Tap to Reveal .

Miranda requirements met - Tap to Reveal

Miranda requirements not met - Tap to Reveal

At the end of the Cerberus coup during " Priority: The Citadel 2 ", your choices regarding the Virmire Surivor will come into play. Each effort you made to build or erode their trust will have contributed to a points total, and the number of points will determine how this confrontation will go.

In particular, having a very high or very low amount of points will result in an automatic outcome. If you're somewhere in the middle, meanwhile, you'll have to pass a Persuasion Check to sway them. Here's how these can go:

High trust points / Pass the Persuasion check - Tap to Reveal

Low trust points / Fail the Persuasion check - Tap to Reveal

After " Priority: Citadel 2 " you'll receive the " Kallini: Ardat-Yakshi Monastery " Mission, which ends with you escaping the destroyed Ardat-Yakshi Monastery with Falere, Samara's daughter. If Samara survived Mass Effect 2, she'll be present as well, which can alter how this scene transpires.

After the " Priority: Geth Dreadnought " Mission, you'll pick up the " Rannoch: Geth Fighter Squadrons " Mission after the debriefing. Whether you complete this before " Priority: Rannoch " or not will have a profound effect on your options at the end of that Mission.

Geth Fighter Squadrons completed - Tap to Reveal

Geth Fighter Squadrons ignored - Tap to Reveal

At the end of " Priority: Rannoch ", you'll have to try and conclude the war between the Geth and Quarians to complete the Mission. There are three possible outcomes, however one of them is locked behind a high Reputation check and specific Quarian / Geth-related decisions in Mass Effect 2 and 3.

"[Rally the fleet]" / "[Warn the fleet]" - Tap to Reveal

At the end of " Priority: Horizon ", you'll have a climactic standoff with Henry Lawson, who is holding his daughter Oriana captive. There is a very specific situation where you can get Miranda killed even if you met every requirement in the Conversations with Miranda.

The situation described here is when you pick "I just want Oriana", which you'll be forced to choose if you don't have enough Reputation to clear the Persuasion Check. When you pick this option, you'll get a Renegade Interrupt as Oriana struggles to get free.

At the finale of Mass Effect 3 , you'll make the last decision of the Mass Effect Trilogy: how to deal with the Reapers. You can have up to three options here, and the availability and effects of each will be determined by your Effective Military Strength, or EMS. The exact details for how to access these and affect their variants are detailed above in the " War Assets and EMS " section.

articles.title: Best Sandevistans and Sandevistan Locations - Cyberpunk 2077 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Sandevistan is the Operating System cyberware David Martinez uses in the Netflix anime Cyberpunk Edgerunners. The special cyberware featured in the anime
articles.body:
The Sandevistan is the Operating System cyberware David Martinez uses in the Netflix anime Cyberpunk Edgerunners . The special cyberware featured in the anime was added with the Edgerunners update as a usable set in Cyberpunk 2077 .

This Cyberpunk 2077 Sandevistan guide details everything you need to know about unlocking Sandevistans, with information on their locations, stats, and more. You can also find our expert opinion on the best Sandevistans and where to find them.

Best Sandevistans and Sandevistan Locations

Are you looking for something specific? Click the links to jump ahead to see each specific Sandevistan:

When it comes to the best Sandevistans, this largely comes down to your playstyle and builds . However, Apogee is a clear winner, thanks to it having the best time dilation of all Sandevistans and great damage-boosting stats. It's what we use in a handful of builds, including a dual-wield build and a melee build .

However, Falcon is a close second, having slightly weaker time dilation but trading the Apogee's more restrictive headshot damage modifier to instead boost all damage. Overall, it still comes out slightly behind the Apogee.

On the flip side, after it was nerfed, the Warp Dancer is by far the weakest, offering the lowest time dilation at just 20%, and providing damage mitigation over damage boosts, which are significantly less useful for most players since there are plenty of other sources of mitigation.

The Dynalar Sandevistan (18 Cyberware Capacity) is one of the three starter-level Sandevistans you can use in Cyberpunk 2077.

Costing a fraction of the price of the other high-end Sandevistans, you can purchase the Dynalar Sandevistan for 50,863 Eurodollars at Level 50 Street Cred.

When active, the Dynalar Sandevistan slows time by 50% for 9 seconds (40 sec. cooldown) and adds a bonus of 15% to both your crit chance and crit damage.

What used to be the best Sandevistan in Cyberpunk 2077, the QianT "Warp Dancer" Sandevistan (14 Cyberware Capacity), is now reduced to being the worst time-slowing OS in the game.

The only positive outcome of this change is that you won't need to hold your punches with Fingers during The Space in Between .

With a duration of 10 seconds, a cooldown of 60 seconds, and only bonuses to defense, it's recommended to save your eddies for other available Sandevistans.

The last of the three Sandevistans available at Level 20, the Zetatech Sandevistan is best suited for those creating a build that excels at midair combat.

While the Zetatech Sandevistan slows down time by only 30%, that number goes up to 60% when it is active in midair. Your overall damage output while shooting in midair also increases by 24%, with an added bonus of 40% to your headshot and weakspot damage.

Though you can purchase this Sandevistan for 50,863 Eurodollars at any Ripperdoc, you can find one for free during the Gig: Prototype in the Scraper .

Militech "Apogee" Sandevistan - Best Sandevistan

The cream of the crop in Sandevistan technology, the iconic Militech "Apogee" Sandevistan is easily the best Sandevistan in the game.

Time is slowed by 85% for everyone but the user.

Increases Headshot Damage Multiplier by 10%. This is increased to 15% at Tier 5++.

Increases Crit Chance by 9%. This is increased to 14% at Tier 5+ and 15% at Tier 5++.

Increases Crit Damage by 13%. This is increased to 15% at Tier 5++.

Neutralizing an enemy when active gives:

Not only are the stats amazing, from its base to its upgraded versions, but the Militech "Apogee" Sandevistan is perhaps the closest to the Sandevistan David Martinez acquired in Cyberpunk Edgerunners.

You can also acquire this Sandevistan for free during the Disasterpiece Main Job.

For those coming back to an old save file, you can get one during Padre's final Gig: Sr Ladrillo's Private Collection .

Second only to the Militech "Apogee" Sandevistan, the Militech "Falcon" Sandevistan was one of the two most used Sandevistan pre-2.0.

However, with its lower base bonuses in comparison to the Apogee, there's really no reason to use the Militech unless you'd rather have more health when activating your Operating System.

Time is slowed by 70% for everyone but the user.

articles.title: Run This Town Walkthrough - Cyberpunk 2077 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: This is the walkthrough of Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty's Run This Town, the eleventh mission in the expansion. Mr. Hands has some work for you, and it
articles.body:
This is the walkthrough of Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty 's Run This Town , the eleventh mission in the expansion. Mr. Hands has some work for you, and it involves taking advantage of the recent death of Dogtown's leader, Kurt Hansen.

Use these links to skip to key sections, including the ending choice:

Go to Mr. Hands' private room at the Heavy Hearts Club and talk to him. Take the datashard on his coffee table.

The shard contains info on Lieutenant Colonel Bennett, Mr. Hands pick for Hansen's replacement.

Hands want you to impersonate Aguilar , a Cuban merc and Hansen's personal assassin. Take the gun, the shard containing the behavioral imprint, and the suit to continue the mission, then use the mirror to activate the cloning process.

When you're done, deactivate the behavioral imprint, leave the club, and get to the meeting point between Jago and the Voodoo Boys .

Get inside the bunker, activate Aguilar's imprint, and wait. You'll need to find a way to eliminate the Voodoo Boys soldiers guarding the meeting point. Stealth is almost impossible here, but Aguilar has a decent amount of HP, so taking all of them head-on is a relatively simple task.

Once you have cleared the area, lean by the rock and wait for Jago to show up. After informing Jago that he has angered the wrong people, he will ask you, "What happens now?" You can respond in three different ways.

Picking option three will make Jago reveal that Bennett is an Arasaka pawn, and they'll use him to take control of Dogtown. This unlocks an optional step to meet with Bennett.

Jago will also direct you to a building in Center City where Bennett conducts his business with Arasaka.

You can immediately inform Mr. Hands of the situation with your new info or investigate Bennett first.

Meet with Bennett before Kurt Hansen's wake in Downtown City Center near Skyline & Republic . Follow the objective marker and activate Aguilar's imprint inside the first garage you see.

Kill Bennett's driver, dump his body in the nearby dumpster, then get inside his car. Bennett will counter Jago's claim, saying that Arasaka only wants the BARGHEST's smuggling routes and not the entirety of Dogtown.

Once you have finished talking to Bennett, leave the car and deactivate the imprint, then call Mr. Hands. He'll instruct you to attend Hansen's wake at the Black Sapphire as Aguilar to ensure a smooth transfer of power within the BARGHEST organization.

Near the entrance to the Black Sapphire, find a quiet corner to activate Aguilar's imprint and wait for the wake to start. Enter the building and take the elevator to the club and casino floor. Jago will escort you to Bennett, and the three of you will speak about the next plan.

At some point in the conversation, Bennett will become paranoid that when Aguilar leaves, Jago will try to stab him in the back again.

You'll have many options here that'll end up with either they both agree to work through their differences or Bennett will kill Jago and make an example of him.

If you pick the first option , you'll have two choices here:

If you pick the second option , you'll have three follow-up choices, including one to kill Bennett:

Generally, the best choice is to have both Bennett and Jago survive , as this will earn you the highest reward from Mr. Hands. To do this, select "Show your weapon | You would plunge Dogtown into chaos?", followed by, "Show your weapon | Accept the fucking terms."

Once you finish the dialogue with those two, leave the Black Sapphire, deactivate the imprint, and then call Mr. Hands to tell him the job is done.

articles.body:
This is the walkthrough of Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty 's From Her to Eternity , the fourteenth and final mission in the expansion if you Tap to Reveal at the end of Killing Moon.

After completing Unfinished Sympathy , you'll soon receive coordinates and a message from an unknown number that reads:

"Return to the place that reminds me of home and see what you find."

Though you can reply to the message, you'll soon get an error notifying you that the number is invalid and your message was not sent.

The place they are hinting at is Tranquil Terrace, where you could have met Songbird previously in Birds with Broken Wings . Go to the coordinates in Dogtown and scan the Hermetic Container on the floor next to the couch.

Inside is a Metal Pin with a description showing that it is a souvenir from the lunar city of Tycho— confirming that it's So Mi who messaged you. Congratulations, you saved her.

The other item is a high-grade and iconic Quantum Tuner that requires 45 Cyberware Slots . This item is great for Netrunner builds or any other build that's racking up cyberware implants.

Pick up both items to complete the quest.

articles.summary: This is the walkthrough of Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty's Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, the twelfth mission in the expansion if
articles.body:
This is the walkthrough of Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty 's Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos , the twelfth mission in the expansion if you choose Tap to Reveal during Firestarter .

Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos Walkthrough

You'll start this main job immediately after Songbird's capture by MaxTax. You'll need a netrunner to help you breach the NCPD system to determine the convoy's route.

The options for which netrunner you can use for this mission depend entirely on your main and side job progress in the base game. Each option also has a different reward.

The best netrunner to call is Carol Emeka, followed by Nix. While Carol can't help you complete the job, you can get an Iconic Sandevistan for free. After that, you can then go to Nix, who is the fastest to complete the task, and doesn't come with any baggage like Chang-Hoon. Although, if you're in it for the story, calling Sandra Dorsett for help is quite poetic, especially given her reasoning for helping.

Optimization: Depending on the order you contact these netrunners, it's actually possible to maximize your rewards.

Call Carol Emeka, then Mr. Hands, followed by Nix.

Meet Nix and collect your reward at the memorial before opening Mr. Hands' text about meeting with Yoko.

Use the nearby Corpo Plaza Apartment fast travel and go to Yoko Tsuru's shop in Kabuki Market.

Speak to her to choose the Mr. Hands path. Later on, this will ensure you get Yoko's reward, too.

Regardless of which netrunner you pick, meet them at the designated location, pick up the datashard, then message Reed.

Meet Reed at the abandoned hotel next to Pacifica's West Wind Apartments. His plan to ambush the convoy carrying Songbird involves the help of the 6th Street Gang. Talk to Reed and wait for the convoy.

You can also send Mr. Hands the coordinates of the ambush site so he can pass them down to Yoko.

You can use multiple vantages and waiting points to ambush the convoy, but it's best to stay on high ground, especially if you plan to use a sniper or other ranged weaponry.

You can decide on the position of turrets and mines, though these don't change the outcome of the quest, so pick whatever you want.

After clearing the initial NCPD convoy officers, open the rear door of the transport truck, and four MaxTax operators will come out.

Each specializes in different combat abilities, but it's best to deal with Jasper Collins first since his hacks can prove bothersome while dealing with the other ones.

Dallas Foster is the juggernaut of the group and arguably the strongest. Leave him for a one-on-one fight at the end after getting rid of the other three.

Once you have defeated all four MaxTax operators, check on Reed, then follow the traces left by Songbird. The mission will be complete as soon as you find the hole she made on the side of a building by ramming it with the truck.

articles.title: The 25 Best Monster Movies of All Time
articles.summary: We count down the best monster movies in cinematic history, from King Kong to Jurassic Park and beyond.
articles.body:
Monster movies can come in many forms: comedy, science fiction, drama, and more. The best ones, though, are usually a unique combination of different genres and feature an unforgettable creature at its heart – with some monsters even having a longer lifespan than the films that birthed them.

But which monster movies are the best of the best? We've picked 25 films that we believe deserve that honor. Some are introductions to iconic movie monsters, some are sequels, and some are homages or remakes. What every movie on this list shares, however, are the thrills that come along with seeing a fantastic beast on the big screen.

With a hundred years of cinema to explore, we've attempted to spread the wealth, from black and white classics to new on-screen terrors, trying not to bunch up too many similar creatures (or directors, for that matter). Selected by a group of IGN editors, this list includes monster movies that influenced the art form of cinema when they were released, feature a unique and memorable monster (or monsters), and still pack a punch today.

Are the real monsters usually us ? Absolutely. But also... these guys. Here are the 25 best monster movies of all time.

John Krasinski proved himself to be a incredibly adept creature feature director (while also making use of Jim Halpert's ability to act with his face) with the harrowing dystopian monster flick A Quiet Place , which takes place in a world where alien beasts now roam Earth mutilating anything that makes a noise. A family tucked away on a remote farm does their best to survive this hush-pocalpyse in a nail-biter of a survive-the-night tale.

Once you've finished this one, make sure to check out the sequel, A Quiet Place: Part 2, and the prequel, A Quiet Place: Day One , which stars Stranger Thing's Joseph Quinn.

More Like This: The Descent (2005), Us (2019)

Deviating slightly from this list's (mostly) full-tilt horror, Little Shop of Horrors is a delightfully macabre murder-comedy about an alien plant, the blood-craving mutant Venus flytrap Audrey 2, who promises the good life (and the love of his life) to a flower shop schlub (Rick Moranis, at his Moranis heights) as long as she gets fed fresh bodies. A musical adaptation of a 1960 Roger Corman film, Little Shop features maliciously catchy songs by Alan Menken and writer Howard Ashman.

More Like This: Little Shop of Horrors (1960), Anna and the Apocalypse (2017), Tremors (1990)

Based on Bram Stoker's 1897 novel (and the stage play from 1924), Dracula kicked off Universal's monster mania, altering the very course of movie history. The story of an ancient, seductive vampire's attempt to relocate from Transylvania to London, Tod Browning's Dracula is pivotal to the entire horror genre and a touchstone for countless monsters going forward. Bela Lugosi's commanding Count is an icon of scary cinema as Dracula became one of the most adapted and explored creepy characters of all time. If you love vampire movies , this is an essential film.

More Like This: Frankenstein (1931), The Mummy (1932), Horror of Dracula (1958)

Nearly a century after F. W. Murnau's silent masterwork Nosferatu, movies were still finding new ways to craft the vampire story and delve into undead lore. 2008's Swedish haunter Let the Right One In follows a bullied, lonely schoolboy who befriends a young, isolated girl in his apartment complex -- only to discover she's a vampire with an elderly caretaker. Young love blooms in this mesmerizing look at lost souls and found family.

More Like This: Let Me In (2010), A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night (2014), Interview With the Vampire (1994)

A decade after Dracula -- which carved space for The Mummy, Frankenstein, The Invisible Man, and more -- and Universal's monster tank had not yet run dry. The Wolf Man , starring Lon Chaney Jr. as a man who returns home to Wales and gets afflicted by a crazed curse, terrified viewers with an all-new nightmare (and game-changing transformation effects for the time). The Wolf Man wasn't the first werewolf movie but it was the one to put frightening lycans on the map in a big way, adding them to the rogues gallery of famous monsters.

More Like This: Creature From the Black Lagoon (1954), The Curse of the Werewolf (1961)

Stephen Sommers' rollicking desert adventure, The Mummy , was a swashbuckling update on Universal's original Mummy movie from 1932. Starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz, The Mummy was part Indiana Jones, part rom-com, as man of action Rick and Egyptologist Evy attempt to thwart the supernatural plot of high priest Imhotep to return to the land of the living. While classic takes on mummies will always be integral to the genre, 1999's The Mummy showed us how fun can mix with frightening and forge a bit of light in the darkness. It's also one of Brendan Frasier's best movies .

More Like This: Deep Rising (1998), The Mummy Returns (2001), Jungle Cruise (2021)

James Gunn's good-natured alien invasion horror-comedy Slither was designed to get under your skin. At some points a brutal body horror hoedown, Slither stars Nathan Fillion as a small-town police chief trying to keep people safe while his sleepy burg is tormented by hive-minded cosmic slugs with a penchant for body snatching. It's a gross-out trip that borrows from the best while also paving new roads. Elizabeth Banks, Michael Rooker, and Jenna Fischer also star.

More Like This: The Stuff (1985), Night of the Creeps (1986), Braindead (1992)

The magic of The Cabin in the Woods is the potential debate over who/what the monster actually is in the movie. There are the literal monsters from the menagerie, of course, but then there are the Ancient Ones as well as the humans who have crafted this whole horrific display in order to please their masters.

Either way, Cabin in the Woods provides a unique spin and analysis of the horror and monster movie tropes, flipping them all on their head and providing a context that reminds us why these kind of movies work so well even when they are campy or absurd.

More Like This: Tucker & Dale vs. Evil (2010), Ready or Not (2019)

Keep them away from bright lights. Don’t get them wet. And, whatever you do, never feed them after midnight. The three rules of caring for Magwai have since penetrated pop culture so completely, almost as much as Gizmo’s adorable face. But more importantly, Joe Dante’s Gremlins is a hilariously clever spin on the monster movie, balancing the line between true terror and absolute camp. It’s got some great puppet work and truly memorable characters, some of them human but most of them not even close.

And setting the whole thing around Christmas, the most wonderful time of the year? Utter genius.

More Like This: Ghoulies (1984), Critters (1986), Gremlins 2: The New Batch (1990)

The Blob is a pinnacle of the 1950s monster movie, with a young Steve McQueen making his film debut in the story of an alien glop that lands in Pennsylvania and just starts consuming everyone around it (and continuously growing larger as a consequence). B-movie royalty, The Blob taps into our fears of "something, anything from outer space" destroying us, even if that entity has no specific form. The special effects may be dated but the terror is still real.

More Like This: The Swarm (1978), The Blob (1988)

The mutilated-yet-seductive Candyman, played by the late Tony Todd, was a Dracula for the late-part of the 20th century. Adapted from a Clive Barker story, the film, which moved the setting from the U.K. to Chicago, coated Candyman with more than just honey. It gave him a tragic socio-political backstory that connected this "monster" to America's rampant, ongoing racism and elevated him to mythical status -- or an urban legend within the once-real Cabrini Green housing projects. 2021's Candyman re-quel even explored more of the idea that there were several Candymen (Candymans?), each birthed from a different local atrocity.

More Like This: Hellraiser (1987), Nightbreed (1990), Candyman (2021)

In the early '90s, "prestige horror" was big business as the genre started attracting A-list directors and stars (The Silence of the Lambs, Misery, Interview With the Vampire, etc.), and a prime example of this was Francis Ford Coppola's Dracula , a lavish updating of the Bram Stoker book with more of an emphasis on the romance between the Count (Gary Oldman) and Mina Harker (Winona Ryder), the woman he believes is the reincarnation of his long dead love. An eye-popping production that creates some surreal moments at times, Dracula is awesome to watch as an example of how the monster movie can transform and branch out.

More Like This: Crimson Peak (2015), Dracula Untold (2014)

If Godzilla set the template for the giant monster movie, it was King Kong that birthed it. A crowning achievement for special effects in Hollywood, the original King Kong blew minds upon release and subsequently became one of the most beloved films of all time, monster movie or not.

It’s chock-full of iconic shot after iconic shot, and ends with the heartbreaking death of the titular beast after we terrible humans try to use him for our amusement. King Kong originated the giant movie monster, both in technological achievements and in the idea that perhaps humanity’s tampering with nature would come back to bite them. (Literally.)

More Like This: Mighty Joe Young (1949), King Kong (2005), Kong: Skull Island (2017)

Cloverfield is the kind of monster movie where the less you know, the better. And by better, we mean scarier. Thanks to the found footage style of the movie, the Cloverfield monster is only seen in rare (and terrifying) glimpses, and the nature of the beast is never explained. Because really, it doesn’t matter.

Taking the position of what it would be like to be on the streets of Tokyo when Godzilla attacked, Cloverfield is an exploration of the genre from the point of view of the average citizen. And man, being in their shoes is much scarier than getting an omniscient view of it all. Not only is Cloverfield one of the best "found footage" films ever, but it's also a prime example of post-9/11 paranoid monsterpocalyse cinema (like War of the Worlds, The Mist, Skyline, Pacific Rim, etc.).

More Like This: War of the Worlds (2005), The Mist (2007), Monsters (2010), 10 Cloverfield Lane (2016)

Put simply, the zombie movie genre as we know it would not exist without George Romero’s original Night of the Living Dead movie. It introduced flesh-eating zombies as we know (and love) them today, and it showed us that a movie full of blood and guts can still have a conscience. Romero’s zombies were terrifying in black and white, but one could even argue who the true monster was in the movie: the undead or the living?

It’s hard to undersell the importance of this movie, but consider the things we wouldn’t have had if it never existed... some of which appear on this very list.

More Like This: Dawn of the Dead (1978), The Return of the Living Dead (1985), Dawn of the Dead (2004)

It's quite possible that no one loves monsters more than Guillermo del Toro, who not only loves to portray them but also sympathizes with them, most often taking their side over that of humans in the stories he crafts. He also loves exploring tragedy through the eyes of children, and the superb Pan's Labyrinth feels like everything the director adores converging on screen. Influenced by fairy tales, the film traverses the realms of man and monster, told from the viewpoint of a 10-year-old girl, Ofelia, as she lives within the hell of Francoist Spain. The makeup used here, and the dependably spindly performance from Doug Jones as both the Faun and the Pale Man, delivered instantly memorable monsters.

More Like This: Hellboy (2004), The Shape of Water (2017), Tigers Are Not Afraid (2017)

Universal’s 1931 Frankenstein was a huge hit that sent Boris Karloff into superstardom, but it was Bride of Frankenstein that proved the true potential of the character beyond the basics of the Mary Shelley novel. The sequel finds Dr. Frankenstein coerced into making a mate for the Monster, and the result is one of the most heartbreaking stories in movie monster history.

The Monster, struggling for two films for love and acceptance from others -- through no fault of his own -- recognizes the futility of his plight and in the end decides that both he and his Bride belong among the dead. The Bride of Frankenstein is one of the most insightful looks at the inner workings of these so-called “monsters” that will make you feel guilty for even considering Karloff's character to be one.

More Like This: Son of Frankenstein (1939), The Bride (1985)

The Monster Movie met '80s Action Movie (and arguably the '80's biggest action star in Arnold Schwarzenegger) in 1987's Predator , in which a towering alien hunter visits Earth to face-off against elite soldiers and collect trophies. Right before Die Hard, director John McTiernan helmed this absolutely kickass showdown between our toughest hero and the galaxy's crowning killing machine. The look of the Predator -- or the "Yautja," as the extra-terrestrial species is known -- is famous both with and without the mask, the mark of makeup master Stan Winston.

See our guide to all of the Predator movies in order .

More Like This: Predator 2 (1990), The Monster (2021), Prey (2022)

7. An American Werewolf in London (1981)

An American Werewolf in London has one of the most unique tones of any on this list, toeing the line between outright horror, black comedy, and intense drama. When he becomes a werewolf during a backpacking trip in England and his friend is killed, David Kessler has to deal with the consequences of becoming a monster and confront the beast inside of him. It’s more complex than that, really, but that’s what’s so special about this movie. It has a dimension to it that is almost indescribable; it needs to be ingested to be fully appreciated. And that transformation sequence? Wow.

It was the standout of the other werewolf movies of 1981 (those being The Howling and Wolfen) and spawned a sequel 16 years later… but we don’t talk about that.

More Like This: The Howling (1981), Ginger Snaps (2000), Dog Soldiers (2002), Werewolves Within (2021)

A monster movie updated for the 1990s, in the burgeoning era of CGI, Jurassic Park is to modern movie-making what King Kong was to the early 20th century. Steven Spielberg had already achieved success with the monster flick back in Jaws, but Jurassic Park and the miracle of computer technology let him do something truly groundbreaking. Gone was the clunky stop motion of previous movie dinosaurs and present were wholly believable Jurassic monstrosities.

Equal parts adventure, horror, and sci-fi thriller, Jurassic Park proved that audiences hadn’t given up on the traditional monster movie, not by a long shot. While modern cinema has since struggled to follow-up on the endearing Jurassic Park (even Spielberg’s own sequel couldn’t manage it), the movie is just as powerful today as it was 30 years ago.

See our guide to all of the Jurassic Park movies .

More Like This: Westworld (1973), The five other Jurassic Park/World films, 65 (2022)

It’s not often that a remake of a monster movie classic can top its predecessor (though it does happen, as this list proves), but David Cronenberg’s The Fly is more successful than the original every step of the way. Its visual imagery is grotesque and innovative, and the performances by the lead cast members are truly exceptional.

But it’s the tragic decline of Seth Brundle into the monstrous fly creature that makes the movie work. When you think about it, it’s equally rare that a monster movie has its star actually become the monster in question (though plenty will have you rooting for the monster over the human protagonist), but The Fly manages to do so and is all the more successful because of it.

More Like This: The Fly (1958), From Beyond (1986), The Invisible Man (2020)

For many, Godzilla is the quintessential monster movie. Launching the kaiju genre in Japan and inspiring loads upon loads of filmmakers, artists, and other creative types, Godzilla set the genre on fire with its social commentary and utter destruction. It was a response to the atomic holocaust in Japan, a suggestion that maybe nature was ready to fight back. Godzilla is still thriving today, with not only reboots from Japan (Shin Godzilla and Godzilla Minus One) but also Legendary's MonsterVerse.

More Like This: Destroy All Monsters (1968), Godzilla (2014), Shin Godzilla (2016)

John Carpenter’s adaptation of Who Goes There? by John W. Campbell (previously adapted by Howard Hawkes in 1951 as The Thing From Another World) is one of the greatest, most effective monster movies of the last 50 years; an oft-referenced horror film that is as psychologically terrifying as it is horrific to watch.

Another example of where the monster in question is felt more often than it’s seen, the claustrophobic setting and the exceptional performances propel the terror forward until such time that the titular Thing is indeed revealed. The Thing still stands as a go-to for gold medal practical effects. The grotesque imagination involved for the alien Thing's ability to become an abominable amalgam of body parts is astonishing.

More Like This: The Thing from Another World (1951), Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1978), Color Out of Space (2019)

Steven Spielberg’s breakthrough blockbuster proved that monster movies still had a calling at the box office, and in fact was the highest-grossing movie of all time -- until Star Wars came out two years later. The tale of a great white shark terrifying a New England beach town takes the less-is-more approach -- due mostly to production problems with the mechanical shark -- but as a result the film’s portrayal of the shark as a bona fide movie monster is much stronger.

Coupled with John Williams’ unforgettable score, terrific performances, and a severed appendage here or there, and Jaws cemented its place as one of the best monster movies ever and for sure the best shark movie .

More Like This: Open Water (2003), The Shallows (2016), Crawl (2019), Nope (2022)

Following up on the success of Jaws, Hollywood brought us another predatory monster movie, this time set in the dead of space. Alien reinvented the idea of aliens in Hollywood, delivering the Xenomorph -- a design that would stretch our imagination as to what extraterrestrials could be and penetrate our innermost fears when we learned that they could, ahem, “impregnate” us.

Alien managed to launch a whole franchise that expanded with even more creatures and even faced-off against other popular monsters in various mediums. But it’s this original film, which puts the focus on the terror of the Xenomorph, that stands as the greatest monster flick ever.

See our guide to all Alien movies in the franchise

More Like This: Aliens (1986), The Abyss (1989), Life (2017), Underwater (2020)

And that's it for our picks of the best monster movies of all time! What's your favorite monster movie? What's missing from our list? Let us know in the comments.

And for more monstrous goodness, check out our picks of the best horror movies of all time and the best modern horror movies .

articles.title: Walmart Announces First Wave of 2026 Black Friday Deals, Starting November 12
articles.summary: Walmart has officially announced its 2026 Black Friday sale dates, starting November 12 with early access for Walmart+ members. Here is what to expect and whether you should wait it out for better deals.
articles.body:
Walmart has officially announced when its first major wave of Black Friday deals will go live , with the retailer's sale kicking off at 12 am ET on November 12. The event promises discounts across a range of major brands, with Walmart+ members once again getting early access before everyone else.

That early access could be handy if you're hoping to pick up something that's likely to sell out quickly. Walmart's holiday sales have previously included restocks of hard-to-find Pokémon TCG products and discounts on gaming accessories, although we'll have to wait and see what makes the cut this year.

Black Friday itself doesn't fall until November 27 this year, but the early November sales have become a familiar part of the holiday shopping calendar. Rather than saving everything for one weekend, retailers are spreading their deals across several events, giving shoppers more opportunities to find discounts before the big day.

Speaking of which, Best Buy has also recently announced its starting sale dates , with its "Door BOOsters" sale starting on October 30 and running through to November 1, while it's early Black Friday sale will kick off on November 6 this year.

That said, there's no need to rush into every offer that catches your eye. Walmart's and Best Buy's upcoming early sales could turn up some worthwhile deals, but we'll certainly be keeping an eye out for further, and potentially better, discounts as Black Friday proper gets closer and closer.

As a reminder, the best offers on gaming, tech, and entertainment will all still likely arrive later in the month (by my predictions, from November 18-22 onwards), so it's probably worth playing it cool and sticking it out a bit longer to get a better deal.

articles.title: Flesh Lily - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: One of the first side quests you will come across in Phantom Blade Zero is Flesh Lily. During the opening of the game, as you explore Weeping Creek Valley, you
articles.body:
One of the first side quests you will come across in Phantom Blade Zero is Flesh Lily. During the opening of the game, as you explore Weeping Creek Valley, you will stumble upon Yu’er. She is a young woman who has escaped Pangzhen, looking to find help for her father, who has become ill.

She divulges that Pangzhen has been overrun by Mandate forces and a sickness of some kind. To cure her father’s sickness, she is hunting for ingredients found in a medicinal recipe, specifically a flower called the Flesh Lily. Due to the danger ahead, Soul suggests that Yu’er wait here, and he will find the flower for her. This begins the Tale side quest: Flesh Lily.

Before you can progress the quest, you need to follow the main story path until you defeat the main boss: Peng Meng, The Axemaster, during the Against The Flow story quest. He is located just after the Outpost bell in Weeping Creek Valley.

He’s a large opponent with plenty of strong strikes, so prepare yourself. These are the special attacks you need to look out for in this fight:

The Axemaster is a slow-moving boss who hits extremely hard. Oftentimes, it’s safer to dodge than attempt a parry, but you’ll want at least a few successful parries to lower his Sha-Chi meter and cause a guard break.

The Axemaster has slow recovery animations after big hits, so stay patient and counterattack when he’s on the ground or regaining his balance. The Jagged Steel sword is great here because it inflicts Bleed and the boss is slow enough to give you generous combo openings.

Beating this fight will also unlock your first Phantom Edge, the Dread Axe.

After Peng Meng has been defeated, rest at the nearby bell in the arena and head back into the Outpost. Next to Forge, the blacksmith in the Outpost, you can find Yu’er.

Speak to her to gain a little bit more information about the Flesh Lily.

Continue on the main story path until you reach the Valley Sha-Chi Tower. At the base of the tower, you can find the bell “Valley Sha-Chi Tower 1st Floor”.

Activate it and save your game, as there is a tough fight ahead.

Walk into the tower and defeat the three shielded enemies in front of you. You can easily defeat them with any charged Phantom Edge attack, as it breaks their shields. Upon defeating them, you will also pick up the Sha-Chi Furnace Inspection Crank, which can be used to complete part of the A Severed Mindseal Tale.

Just to the right of the central column on this first floor, a ramp sits at the back of the room next to a pipe.

Slide down it and defeat the grunt enemies lingering out down here.

Follow the path of red flowers, around to the left to find Hua, Deadly Betrothed. This is one of the first side bosses in the game, and a tough fight this early on.

Hua is a tough fight with several deadly mechanics in her moveset that can be hard to manage at first. But learning how she fights, behaves, and how her poisonous flowers work will make the fight easier to tackle.

Beyond the three main mechanics of the fight, Hua is largely an endurance fight, asking you to parry sword attacks, and continuously maintain your parry timing to wear down her Sha-Chi meter. She will also constantly teleport around the arena after combos, in-between combos, and before starting her attacks towards you, requiring you to be constantly on the ball.

These are the key moves and mechanics you need to learn and watch out for:

You can slink in-between them as they spin, but be warned if you hit one, you will get stunned and fall to one knee, opening you up for a grab attack.

Parry these just as she swings her sword down to deal a lot of Sha-Chi damage and open Hua up for a combo.

She can also perform this attack on its own. It will deal remove about 60% of your health if you get caught by this attack.

With this fight, you want to learn the parry timings over dodging, unless dealing with the various flowers she spawns and landing one or two hits in-between combos and at the end of attack chains. We suggest using the Sanguine Reach weapon, due to its range and impressive combos as you won't always be right next to Hua due to the amount of moving around she does.

When her Sha-Chi meter has been depleted, this gives you a key opportunity to land a heavy attack combo. When her Sha-Chi meter is around half full, you can also use a fully charged Dread Axe Phantom Edge attack to deal a massive chunk of health damage.

Simply repeat this over and over by continuously stunning Hua until you outlive the amount of poisonous flower attacks she spawns and deplete her health. Chances are you will make it through this fight by the skin of your teeth.

Upon defeating her, you will get the Scarlet Wraithblade weapon, which allows you to spawn those same deadly flowers from your own attacks.

Sitting at the base of the altar where Hua was standing at the start of the fight are the Twin Flesh Lilies. Pick the item up.

Travel back to the Outpost to talk to Yu’er. Speak to her one final time and she will hand you back one of the Flesh Lilies, giving you the item: Flesh Lily (which will come in handy later)

articles.title: GAA All-Stars 2026: All-Ireland champions Mayo earn six awards as 11 first-time winners named
articles.summary: Six of the team that helped Mayo end their 75-year wait for All-Ireland glory are recognised in a line-up featuring eight different counties.
articles.body:
Six of the team that helped Mayo end their 75-year wait for All-Ireland glory have been recognised in the 2026 All-Stars.

Defenders Sam Callinan and Enda Hession and forwards Darragh Beirne and Kobe McDonald have been selected alongside Footballer of the Year nominees Jack Carney and Ryan O'Donoghue, who also won an All-Star in 2021.

McDonald - who has since embarked on his Australian Football League career - and Beirne are also nominated for Young Footballer of the year.

Kerry superstar David Clifford - who is also competing for his fourth Footballer of the Year title - picks up his seventh award alongside Kingdom team-mates Jason Foley and Shane Murphy.

Clifford's seventh All-Star brings him alongside Kerry great Mikey Sheehy and closer to Colm Cooper (eight) and Pat Spillane (nine).

There are eight different counties represented - the most since 2010 - and 11 first-time winners, the most since 2022.

Enduring memories and 'imposter syndrome' - The GAA Social meets Mayo star Carney

There are three first-time inclusions from Ulster counties: dynamic Armagh wing-back Jarly Og Burns, totemic Tyrone midfielder Conn Kilpatrick and skilful Monaghan wing-forward Stephen O'Hanlon.

Burns - the son of GAA president Jarlath Burns - was instrumental in helping Armagh end an 18-year wait for an Ulster title, while Kilpatrick shone for the Red Hands before helping his club Edendork win their first Tyrone championship last week.

Westmeath captain Ronan Wallace is recognised after helping the Lake County win their first Leinster SFC title in 22 years, while Louth's Dara McDonnell is included at centre-back after starring in the Wee County's run to the All-Ireland semi-finals.

McDonnell is also up for Young Footballer of the Year against McDonald and Beirne.

Niall Scully is Dublin's sole inclusion, his second All-Star after picking up his first in 2020.

"An incredible football season that was crammed full of memorable twists and turns has a legacy in this All-Star football team, one that reflects just how competitive our game is now," said GAA president Burns.

"Mayo have had their season rightly rewarded, and with eight counties represented and 11 first-time winners, there will be clubs all over Ireland that wake up and share in this fantastic news and feel that they have played a part in this success.

"It will be an extraordinary honour and privilege to be able to present my own club's first-ever All-Star award to Jarly Óg and Silverbridge."

The 2026 All-Stars ceremony - where the Footballer of the Year will be crowned - takes place in Dublin's RDS Centre on Friday evening.

2. Kobe McDonald (Crossmolina Deel Rovers, Mayo)

3. Dara McDonnell (Naomh Máirtín, Louth)

articles.title: GTA 6 Dog Poop Gameplay Premieres in the Latest Episode of South Park
articles.summary: GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop.
articles.body:
GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop.

The latest episode of Trey Parker and Matt Stone’s hit comedy series, titled Guinea Pig On A Stick, shows a dog doing a poo on a beach (this is South Park after all!). The NPC dog walker picks up the poo, and here things get a little messy. We see Jason attack the NPC with the dog poo, which explodes in their face. That's one way to start a fight.

The gameplay is shown during a scene in which the main characters visit a cattle ranche, where a woman hypes up GTA 6 by providing a quick look at the game. “The graphics are seriously next level,” the woman says. “You see the worldbuilding? It’s a dog taking a poop. And people can pick up the dog poop. You can throw things at the person with dog poop, and if they choose to fight back, you can pick up the dog poop and actually attack them with the dog poop. That is what’s coming in November.”

“Wow!” Stan says. “Holy s**t!” Kyle exclaims. “Dude, that game looks f***ing tits!” Cartman offers.

Here’s the FULL GTA 6 gameplay footage exclusively shown in the latest South Park episode in HD. — GTA 6 Info (@GTASixInfo) October 29, 2026

Here’s the FULL GTA 6 gameplay footage exclusively shown in the latest South Park episode in HD.

The woman is voiced by Tish Hicks (as confirmed in the credits of the episode). Hicks is a voice actor who narrated the GTA 5 gameplay trailer all those years ago, so fans will probably find her voice familiar.

As for the gameplay, Rockstar had confirmed the dog poop mechanic already, but it’s fun to see it in action. And it’s great to get a sense of the density of NPCs on the beach in gameplay, too, given this sort of scene has been at the heart of official pre-launch videos and screenshots.

South Park is of course no stranger to video games, with its 2006 World of Warcraft episode perhaps the most high-profile example of Parker and Stone taking aim at the culture. But it’s also had plenty to say about Rockstar games, too. articles.title: Phantom Blade Zero Gets Off to a Flyer on Steam, Behind Only Counter-Strike 2 as the Most-Played Game
articles.summary: It’s only been out a few hours, but Phantom Blade Zero is already a big hit on Steam, topping the best-selling games chart, and reaching a huge peak concurrent player count of 448,000.
articles.body:
It’s only been out a few hours, but Phantom Blade Zero is already a big hit on Steam, topping the best-selling games chart, and reaching a huge peak concurrent player count of 448,000.

Phantom Blade Zero is ahead of eternal Steam big hitters PUBG and Dota 2 by peak concurrent players, and behind only Counter-Strike 2 as the most-played game on Valve's platform. But it's worth noting that the total peak player count will be even higher, given Phantom Blade Zero is also out on PS5 (Sony does not make player numbers public).

It's also the best-selling game on Steam by revenue, ahead of Activision Modern Warfare 4, Aion 2, and Probably Stolen, a Cyberpunk shopkeeper sim that's going viral.

Phantom Blade Zero - Donnie Yen Behind the Scenes Photos

The early success shouldn't come as a huge surprise. This week, it was estimated that Phantom Blade Zero had sold over 1 million copies before launch , across launch platforms Steam and PS5, and Tencent’s WeGame (an online PC storefront in China). Nearly two thirds of total prelaunch sales were from China, Taiwan, or Hong Kong. Phantom Blade Zero is a wuxia action game developed by Chinese studio S-Game, and features martial arts movie star Donnie Yen.

Alongside the launch of the game, creative director and S-Game CEO, Soulframe Liang, penned a heartfelt letter thanking fans. In it, he talked about the game’s humble beginnings — a version of the world he created as a student in RPG Maker called Rainblood: Town of Death.

“Back then, I had no idea where my life or career would lead,” he said. “Making games had simply been a source of comfort while I studied abroad, but before I knew it, it had become one of the most important parts of my life.

“More than three years ago, when we brought our first, still rather rough Phantom Blade Zero trailer to a PlayStation showcase, we probably looked like a new studio being a little too bold, putting an unfinished game out for the whole world to judge. Phantom Blade was simply another original IP, its world, characters and story entirely unfamiliar to people.”

He went on to explain how the reaction to the trailer spurred the team on, and they cancelled other projects to focus on Phantom Blade while expanding the scale of production. They travelled across China to 3D scan villages, captured thousands of hours of motion capture, and went to Shaolin temples and sword masters to learn martial arts.

Soulframe also called out a few young and hungry developers on the team, such as art director Michael Chang, who drew concepts for every single character and environment. “After years of development, I feel that technology and experience have become the baseline, almost a given at this point,” he continued. “What I find myself paying more attention to now is the mindset of the people behind the game. Beyond skill and experience, is there a certain madness, a certain obsession?”

Soulframe explained that over time, the team started to feel like wuxia characters themselves, fighting battles each day to make the best game possible. “Over the past few years, one thing I often said to the team was, ‘Today, I have a suffocating decision to announce,’” he explained. “That usually meant taking apart something everyone had already carefully built and polished, then rebuilding it, or even abandoning it altogether.

“It meant a great deal of rework, and sometimes letting go of content that had already taken an enormous amount of time and effort. I am deeply grateful to the team for their understanding and support. We did it. We have poured all our thought and creativity into this game.”

He finished the post off by thanking players who followed the game’s journey from scrappy indie game to topping the Steam charts on its first day out.

IGN's Phantom Blade Zero review returned a 9/10. We said: "Phantom Blade Zero is an unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger."

articles.title: Asha Sharma Insists There's 'More Demand Than Consoles Available' as Xbox Hardware Sales Continue to Plummet
articles.summary: The boss of Xbox has insisted that sales of the console are constrained by supply and that there is “more demand than consoles available,” as Microsoft’s gaming business heads into the crucial holiday season.
articles.body:
The boss of Xbox has insisted that sales of the console are constrained by supply and that there is “more demand than consoles available,” as Microsoft’s gaming business heads into the crucial holiday season.

Microsoft reported its FY27 Q1 results overnight, and the Xbox struggle is a familiar one despite new CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of the gaming business. During the three months ending September 30, 2026, overall Xbox revenue declined 2% year-on-year, although that’s an improvement on the 10% decline the previous quarter.

Xbox content and services revenue decreased 2% and 1% in constant currency, driven by “declines in third-party content and Xbox Game Pass, partially offset by growth in first-party content.” Xbox hardware sales, meanwhile, fell 14%. Xbox console sales, which have seen a number of price rises, have struggled for some time now, and Microsoft hasn't reported a sales figure for the Series X and S for years.

Despite the financial struggles, Xbox is still a huge business. It brought in $5.379 billion in the quarter ($5.508 billion the same quarter last year). But Xbox is a small piece of the overall Microsoft pie. To put Xbox into context, Microsoft’s cloud computing platform, Azure, brought in an eye-watering $33.1 billion this quarter alone — six times more than Xbox.

It’s worth noting that the recently released Gears of War: E-Day and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 came after the end of Q1, so any revenue attributed to those games will be calculated in the current quarter’s results. Q2, by the way, also includes the likes of World of Warcraft: Forever, which looks like a surefire hit for Blizzard, and the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6.

Sharma took to X / Twitter to discuss the results, insisting Xbox’s “accountability margin,” which is understood to be profit margin, improved this quarter. Sharma’s restructure of Xbox, which has seen thousands of staff lose their jobs, multiple studios leave the fold, and various projects shut down, was explained in the summer as part of an effort to improve this “accountability margin” figure. Xbox is now doubling down on its big hitters, such as Minecraft, Fallout, and The Elder Scrolls, in a bid to improve its financial outlook.

Minecraft and WoW Forever “set records,” (in the case of WoW Forever, we’re talking about the hugely popular beta). Neither Activision nor Microsoft has announced sales for Modern Warfare 4, instead pointing to the critical acclaim Infinity Ward’s shooter has enjoyed. “Call of Duty had its most acclaimed release in more than a decade,” Sharma said. PC platform revenue, though, grew “double digits” (we don’t know how much exactly, or what that means in dollar terms).

Every Video Game Franchise Xbox Owns After Acquiring Activision Blizzard

And then Sharma’s main point: “Console sales remain constrained by supply, with more demand than consoles available. We’re working to get more consoles into players’ hands, including through our expanded refurbishment program. We’re making progress, with a lot more work ahead.”

Last week, IGN reported on how Xbox was sending emails to customers reminding them that they could trade in their Series X and S consoles if they were collecting dust. The email was reportedly sent to customers in the U.S. who hadn’t used their console in some time.

The past year or so has seen console prices skyrocket thanks to the 'RAMpocalypse' sparked by generative AI companies such as OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Microsoft itself gobbling up components. As these AI companies vie for dominance and hoard all the RAM, prices soar for the end user while hardware is harder than ever to get hold of.

Console price rises and shortages come at the worst time for Microsoft but also for Sony, with November's launch of GTA 6 expected to spark a surge of interest in all things gaming. Given the game launches on console only, Rockstar's epic is sure to lead to a dramatic rise in console sales, but will Microsoft and Sony meet demand?

Microsoft’s outlook for Q2 and Xbox is surprisingly muted, given GTA 6 comes out and Modern Warfare 4 will count towards the bottom line. The company said that it expects growth in Xbox content and services to be in the mid to high-single digits, “up sequentially driven by the timing of content launches across both third- and first-party.”

“With content launch patterns through the year, we expect growth to be strongest in the second quarter, with some deceleration in Q3 and further moderation in Q4. Hardware revenue in Q2 should decline year-over-year.”

articles.body:
Festering Secret is an early-game side quest found in the Weeping Creek Valley area of Phantom Blade Zero . As a Tale quest, it is missable but can be easy to stumble upon due to its proximity to a main hub in the region.

Festering Secret has you explore an area in the Outpost in the Weeping Creek Valley to discover what lurks within. Opposite the Forge, next to the Outpost bell, look to the right to find a chained wall and two soldiers guarding it. They will mutter to themselves and when Soul finishes overhearing the conversation the Tale Festering Secret will begin.

Before you can even complete the first stage of the Tale, you need to earn the Dread Axe Phantom Edge, which is unlocked upon defeating Peng Meng, the Axemaster. He is a main story boss, located just after the Outpost during the Against The Flow quest.

He’s a large opponent with plenty of strong strikes, so prepare yourself. These are the special attacks you need to look out for in this fight:

The Axemaster is a slow-moving boss who hits extremely hard. Oftentimes, it’s safer to dodge than attempt a parry, but you’ll want at least a few successful parries to lower his Sha-Chi meter and cause a guard break.

The Axemaster has slow recovery animations after big hits, so stay patient and counterattack when he’s on the ground or regaining his balance. The Jagged Steel Sword is great here because it inflicts Bleed and the boss is slow enough to give you generous combo openings.

Beating this fight will also unlock your first Phantom Edge, the Dread Axe.

Return to the Outpost and use the Dread Axe on the wall.

Explore the area behind this wall, defeating the two enemies that spawn. The guards will help you out.

Up the stairs on the left, you can find one more enemy which will drop a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment .

Defeating these three enemies in this sealed area will complete this objective as you have seen what is behind the gated off area.

Head back to the entrance of the Outpost, where you first came in and talk to the Swordsman Captain, who is sitting on the rock. He will inform you of the Mandate encampment.

At the end of the conversation, you will obtain the Written Order Wulin Tales Book.

You will now need to progress further into the Weeping Creek Valley.

articles.title: Helldivers 2 Review Bombed on Steam After Anti-Cheat Friendly Fire
articles.summary: Arrowhead has switched to Easy Anti-Cheat to cut down on cheaters in Helldivers 2, but that decision has proven controversial on Steam. The new anti-cheat was supposed to prevent mods that give players unfair advantages, but it’s broken mods players use to tidy up the game.
articles.body:
Arrowhead has switched to Easy Anti-Cheat to cut down on cheaters in Helldivers 2 , but that decision has proven controversial on Steam. The new anti-cheat was supposed to prevent mods that give players unfair advantages, but it’s broken mods players use to tidy up the game.

"We know mods are part of the DNA of PC gaming and gaming communities as a whole," the studio wrote in a post last week. "In general, we appreciate the creativity behind cosmetic and non-gameplay mods, which players can enjoy without negatively impacting those who play alongside them.

"Where we need to improve is how we protect players against modifications that create unfair advantages or negatively impact others, which goes beyond software manipulation to tamper with our game."

Following the change, recent reviews on Steam plummeted to “Mostly Negative,” while all-time reviews of the game remain “Mostly Positive.” Many have called out Arrowhead for punishing players for using mods that fix, in their opinion, issues with the game the developer has failed to address.

Useful mods include hellpod steering fixes, smoother vaulting and climbing mechanics, AI improvements, and more. Easy Anti-Cheat doesn’t differentiate between these and, say, mods that give players invincibility.

Some players have claimed the anti-cheat blocked them from launching the game at all, despite no mod installs. Currently, in the UK, the game doesn’t even appear on Steam.

“Arrowhead could have embraced the mods,” one Steam review said. “There could have been Workshop support, Left 4 Dead 2 is still thriving to this day. Arrowhead could have had public vanilla lobbies separate from modded ones. Baldur’s Gate 3 has this!”

Helldivers 2 is a co-op game where players work together to fight off various alien races across the galaxy, as enemies fill the screen, bullets fly, and your squadmates die in horrible and hilarious ways. From Arrowhead’s perspective, mods could help you grind to unlock all those cosmetics you could otherwise pay real money for.
